versions.changelog: Round 24: deep fragmentation analysis and redundancy governance

Initial release of the API 代码生成器免费版 (API code generator free version):

- Generate basic API scaffolding from scratch, including RESTful CRUD endpoints (Express.js), GraphQL schema, and Jest+Supertest test suites.
- All generated code outputs to stdout for easy redirection to your project.
- Free version supports three commands: rest, graphql, and test.
- Advanced features (OpenAPI docs, Python client, mock server, authentication code, rate limiter) require upgrade to the paid version.
- Includes clear usage instructions, error handling, and example workflows for quick onboarding.
- MIT licensed.
